_comment: Written by scripts/econ/models.mjs (edit that, not this). Player models: fixed named modules (docs/parts-redesign.md). `legacy`: the family each legacy function migrates to.

models.name: Pip
models.description: Starter cannon with light, quick shells. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Hammer
models.description: Fires one slow, heavy, armour-piercing shell a second. Fixed: aim with the ship.

augment.name: Breaching charge
augment.say: its slug punches one grade deeper and bursts inside

models.name: Twinlink
models.description: Paired cannon turret. Fires a burst of 8 heavy rounds, then reloads. Turret: turns to your aim.

augment.name: Tracer lock
augment.say: a tight stream twice as fast, harder-hitting, that reaches much further

models.name: Longbarrel
models.description: Hold to charge. When full it fires one long-range shot by itself. Fixed: aim with the ship.

augment.name: Penetrator
augment.say: its round goes on through two more ships

models.name: Bastion
models.description: Fires 2 huge, slow shells, then takes a long time to reload. Fixed: aim with the ship.

augment.name: Shatter
augment.say: each ball bursts in a 200 blast

models.name: Rattler
models.description: Fires a steady stream of shells at a fixed rate. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Chainsaw
models.description: Fire rate rises from 2.5 to 7.5 shots a second while you hold fire. Turret: turns to your aim.

augment.name: Incendiary belt
augment.say: every round sets the part it hits burning

models.name: Stinger
models.description: Fires accurate bursts of 6 fast shots, then reloads. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Burst
models.description: Fires a flak shell that bursts at your aim point, or sooner near a target. Good against swarms and missiles. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Cloudmaker
models.description: Fires 4 flak shells in a row that burst at your aim point, or sooner near a target, then reloads. Turret: turns to your aim.

augment.name: Wide burst
augment.say: bursts half again as wide and 60% harder

models.name: Lobber
models.description: Lobs a shell over everything to burst at your cursor. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Lobber
guide.blurb: Mortar that lands at your cursor

models.name: Quake
models.description: Fires 3 shells that land in a line: short of your aim point, on it and past it. Uses 3 rounds a salvo. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Glint
models.description: Charges, then fires a long-range pulse that hits hardest at its peak. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Cutter
models.description: Short held beam. Its damage rises the longer it stays on one part, and starts over if it slips off. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Searchlight
models.description: Long, thin beam that does little damage. What it lights takes 20% more damage from everyone for 2 s. Turret: turns to your aim.

augment.name: Sear
augment.say: its marking beam burns twice as hot

models.name: Strobe
models.description: Fires bursts of 2 bolts that do extra damage to shields and less to hull. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Overpulse
models.description: Fires a clip of 6 fast bolts, then reloads. Very strong against shields, weak against hull. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Dart
models.description: Fires a missile that homes on the ship nearest your cursor. Point defence stops it with 1 hit. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Swarm
models.description: Fires pairs of small rockets while you hold fire. They home on the ship nearest your cursor. Point defence stops each with 1 hit. One round a pair. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Hammerhead
models.description: Fires a slow, heavy missile. While you hold fire it flies toward your cursor; let go and it flies straight. Point defence needs 2 hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Needle
models.description: Fires a long thin slug that goes through 2 ships. Uses slugs from your cargo and needs no power. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Coilgun
models.description: Fires 3 heavy slugs in a tight cone. Short range. Needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

augment.name: Choke
augment.say: a tight, heavy pattern that carries twice as far

models.name: Spear
models.description: Fires a slug that goes through 3 ships at full damage, with a shock ring at each. Needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Hush
models.description: Fires an orb that bursts on its fuse or beside a ship, switching off its engines and guns for 2 s. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Blackout
models.description: Hold to charge; it fires by itself when full. The orb bursts at your aim point or beside a ship, switching off engines and guns over a wide area. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Spark
models.description: Fires a fast bolt that jumps to 3 more ships near what it hits, weaker each jump. Turret: turns to your aim.

augment.name: Storm coil
augment.say: its arc leaps to six targets, further apart

models.name: Tesla
models.description: Hold to zap 5 times a second. Each zap jumps to 5 more ships nearby, weaker each jump. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Eel
models.description: Fires a slow homing torpedo that goes through shields. Point defence needs 3 hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Leviathan
models.description: Fires a huge torpedo that goes through shields. It flies straight, does not home, and arms 0.5 s after launch. Point defence needs 5 hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Lance
models.description: Short, heavy held beam that pierces and does 20% more damage to armour. It sputters when short of power. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Rustjaw's Hive
models.description: Holds 8 seekers and fires 4 at a time, each homing on a different ship near your cursor. Used seekers regrow one at a time. Point defence stops each with 1 hit. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Frostbite Lance
models.description: Held freezing beam. The ship it touches loses 40% of its thrust and turning while lit and for 0.7 s after. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Cinder Bloom
models.description: Fires shells that set the part they hit burning for 5 s. The fire spreads to its neighbours. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Prism Splitter
models.description: Fires a crystal bolt that splits at your cursor into a fan of 5 shards, so you choose where the fan opens. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Phase Cannon
models.description: Fires a slow round that passes through rock, wrecks and shields to hit the hull, and goes on through 2 ships. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Singularity Launcher
models.description: Fires a slow orb that stops at your cursor, pulls nearby ships toward it for a few seconds, then explodes. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Ion Drive
models.description: Efficient, steady engine with a low top speed.

models.name: Vernier
models.description: Small, cheap thruster for extra push. Boosting does not change it.

models.name: Afterburner
models.description: Low thrust normally, very high when boosting. Works best next to a Drive Cell.

models.name: Torch
models.description: Full thrust at all times, with high power use. It has no boost.

models.name: Plasma Drive
models.description: Main engine with balanced thrust, power use and boost.

models.name: Drift Sail
models.description: Uses almost no power, but gives little thrust.

models.name: Fusion Torch
models.description: Large engine with high thrust and the highest top speed.

models.name: Cell Reactor
models.description: The starter generator. Explodes when destroyed.

models.name: Isotope Pile
models.description: Weak but tough generator that never explodes.

models.name: Fusion Plant
models.description: Heavy generator with plenty of power and a big blast when destroyed.

models.name: Overclock Reactor
models.description: The most power for its size. Fragile, with the biggest blast when destroyed.

models.name: Battery
models.description: Stores power and gives it out quickly.

models.name: Capacitor
models.description: Small power store that gives its power out in a rush, for guns and beams that need a burst.

models.name: Drive Cell
models.description: Bigger power store for the engines and Burst Strafers. Gives its power out steadily.

models.name: Heavy Bank
models.description: Deep, heavy power store. Holds a lot, but gives it out slowly.

models.name: Mining Laser
models.description: Cuts ore from rock (hold the right mouse button). Weak as a weapon.

models.name: Bore
models.description: Heavy cutter that breaks harder rock than a Mining Laser.

models.name: Demolition Launcher
models.description: Fires mining charges that stick to rock, blink for a second, then blow it open. Harmless to ships. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Siphon
models.description: Collects gas from gas pockets into your cargo (hold the right mouse button on one).

models.name: Scanner
models.description: Quick short-range sweep that reads rocks and finds seams.

models.name: Long-Range Array
models.description: Slow sweep that reaches twice as far as a Scanner.

models.name: Constructor
models.description: Builds structures piece by piece.

models.name: Deflector
models.description: Standard shield. Soaks damage before the hull. Recharges 8 HP a second per cell, starting 3 s after the last hit.

models.name: Flicker Screen
models.description: Thin, cheap shield. Recharges 20 HP a second per cell, starting 1 s after the last hit.

models.name: Bulwark Projector
models.description: Deep shield that soaks a big hit. Recharges only 5 HP a second per cell, starting 4 s after the last hit.

models.name: Jump Coil
models.description: Adds jump drive capacity for a bigger hull.

models.name: Heavy Coil
models.description: Dense coil with more jump capacity per cell. Jump cooldown 20% shorter.

models.name: Reactive Armour
models.description: Armour that resists small, fast hits.

models.name: Spaced Plating
models.description: Layered armour that takes half damage from blasts.

models.name: Flash Screen
models.description: Shield with no gradual recharge. When it breaks it comes back at full after 4 s, or at once if its own store is full. The store refills from its power line.

models.name: Rail Driver
models.description: Fires one heavy shot per click (up to 5 a second), 4 shots a clip, then reloads. A second Rail Driver takes turns with it. Needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

augment.name: Coil boost
augment.say: half again the damage, a third faster

models.name: Repair Beam
models.description: Repairs the friendly part its beam lands on. Hold fire on a party member or ally. It can't repair your own ship, destroyed parts or shields. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Point Defence Turret
models.description: Shoots down incoming missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells and seekers by itself. Bigger ones need more hits. It never fires at ships or at boss shots. Turret: aims itself.

models.name: Burst Strafer
models.description: Dodge thruster. A short, strong burst away from its nozzle that uses a lot of power. Fit several facing different ways to dodge in any direction. No cruising thrust.

models.name: Tow Beam
models.description: Tows a wreck, debris or loot pod on a tether so you can bring it to a station for salvage. It cannot tow working ships. Uses power only while towing.

models.name: Conduit
models.description: Power line. Passes power between the parts it touches.

models.name: Diode
models.description: One-way power line. Power flows out of its front only; parts on its other sides can only feed it. Its front must touch a part.

models.name: Gyro
models.description: Adds turning force wherever it sits. Uses power only while turning. Heavier than plain hull.

models.name: Heavy Gyro
models.description: Adds a lot of turning force for big ships, wherever it sits. Uses power only while turning. Heavy.

models.name: Joiner Bank
models.description: Battery that joins two power lines into one. Both inputs are at its back; the output is at its front left.

models.name: Splitter Bank
models.description: Battery that splits one power line into two. The input is at its back left; both outputs are at its front.

models.name: Elbow Joiner Bank
models.description: Battery that joins two power lines into one around a corner. Both inputs are at its back; the output is at its right end (flip it for the left).

models.name: End Joiner Bank
models.description: Battery that joins two power lines from its two ends into one. The output is at its front left.

models.name: Cross Joiner Bank
models.description: Battery that joins a power line from its back and one from its front into one. The output is at its right end.

models.name: Elbow Splitter Bank
models.description: Battery that splits one power line into two, one straight on and one round a corner. The input is at its back left; the outputs are at its front left and right end.

models.name: Tee Splitter Bank
models.description: Battery that splits a power line from its left end into two. The outputs are at its front left and back left.

models.name: End Splitter Bank
models.description: Battery that splits one power line into two out of its ends. The input is at its back left; the outputs are at its left and right ends.

models.name: Surge Cell
models.description: Small fast power store. It gives power out much faster than it takes it in, for guns that need a burst after a pause.

models.name: Corner Conduit
models.description: Power line that turns a corner: in at the back, out to the right (flip it for the left).

models.name: Combiner
models.description: Adds a feed from a pipe at its left side to the power line out of its front, so a gun or engine down the line can use it. Batteries block the feed. Tough.

models.name: Passthrough
models.description: Power line with a pipe through it, side to side. The only way a pipe crosses a power line.

models.name: Feed Pipe
models.description: Pipe that joins tanks, Selectors, Combiners and guns with feed inputs, on any side. It carries no power.

models.name: Selector
models.description: Two feeds in (left and right), one out (front). You switch which one passes with the Switch tanks key. Feed already in the lines runs out first.

models.name: Overcharge Tank
models.description: A tank of Overcharge. Guns hit 30% harder and pause half as long after a shot, but use 40% more power a shot. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Coolant Tank
models.description: A tank of Coolant. Guns pause half as long after a shot and between beam pulses, but do 15% less damage. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Damping Gel Tank
models.description: A tank of Damping Gel. Heavy guns need half the steady power to charge, but fire 25% slower. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Flux Salts Tank
models.description: A tank of Flux Salts. Guns use 30% less power a shot, but do 15% less damage. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Accelerant Tank
models.description: A tank of Accelerant. Guns fire 30% faster, but use 25% more power a shot and need more steady power to charge. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Lens Fluid Tank
models.description: A tank of Lens Fluid. Beams use 25% less power, but do 10% less damage and pause longer between pulses. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Catalyst Tank
models.description: A tank of Catalyst. Engines use 40% less power, for 15% less thrust. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Reaction Mass Tank
models.description: A tank of Reaction Mass. Engines give 40% more thrust for the same power. A Reaction Thruster runs on it. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Burst Gel Tank
models.description: A tank of Burst Gel. Boost is 50% stronger for half the extra power, with 10% less cruising thrust. Holds 120. Pipes join it on any side. Refilled in the hangar.

models.name: Reaction Thruster
models.description: Weak on power alone; 5 times the thrust with Reaction Mass piped to its left side. Leaves your power for the guns, but needs tanks and space.

models.name: Slurry Cannon
models.description: Heavy cannon that needs power at its back left and a feed (Overcharge, Accelerant or Flux Salts) at its back right to fire. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Field Fabricator
models.description: Builds and repairs parts from your cargo while you fly, up to Mk II. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Fabrication Bay
models.description: Builds and repairs parts from your cargo, up to Mk III, 1.6 times as fast as a Field Fabricator. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Assembly Forge
models.description: Builds and repairs any part from your cargo, 2.5 times as fast as a Field Fabricator. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Field Refiner
models.description: Refines ore in your cargo while you fly, up to Mk II, at 0.4 times a station's speed. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Refinery Bay
models.description: Refines ore in your cargo, up to Mk III, at 0.7 times a station's speed. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Smelter Forge
models.description: Refines any ore in your cargo at a station's speed. Uses power only while it works. One per ship.

models.name: Mine Bay
models.description: Drops proximity mines out of its open edge when you press its key. Your fabricator refills it. Mines never go off for you or your party.

models.name: Docking Clamp
models.description: Locks two ships together. Line it up with another ship's Docking Clamp and both pilots accept. One pilot steers.

models.name: Heavy Docking Clamp
models.description: Two-cell clamp for bigger ships that locks only to another Heavy Docking Clamp. Line them up and both pilots accept.

models.name: Spark Wall
models.description: Small flat shield wall, 2 cells wide, just off the hull. Cheap and quick to return.

models.name: Guard Wall
models.description: Flat shield wall, 3 cells wide, 1 cell out. Covers a gun and its neighbours.

models.name: Rampart
models.description: Large, deep flat shield wall, 5 cells wide, 2 cells out. Slow to return.

models.name: Visor
models.description: Tight 60 degree shield arc in front of a gun.

models.name: Buckler
models.description: Small 90 degree shield arc close to the hull.

models.name: Shell
models.description: 120 degree shield arc that wraps most of a side.

models.name: Half-dome
models.description: 180 degree shield dome over one end. Deep and slow to return.
